notes.title: Laser Disco Defenders Is Coming To Rezzed
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Chris here, I'm the Product Manager for Excalibur Games. Today I'd like to announce that we will be taking Laser Disco Defenders to EGX Rezzed this week. Alexander Birke will be on hand this Thursday at the stand so if you have any questions or want to just come over and say hi, Thursday is your best bet!

Details on EGX rezzed can be found here:

https://www.egx.net/rezzed

Laser Disco Defenders still has had some great impressions from many reviewers and has been released on both the PS4 and the PS Vita. If you want to give the game a shot on Playstation you can pick it up from the following link:

https://store.playstation.com/#!/search/q=laser%20disco%20defenders

Additionally there will be several other developers who work with Excalibur Games and these include:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/390870/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/446020/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/524250/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/546350/

There will also be a new game called Floatlands which will debut at the show

www.floatlands.net

We hope to see you there if you plan on attending!

notes.title: Laser Disco Defenders Is Out Now On PS4... Gig Ticket Competition
notes.content:
[img]http://imgur.com/OF8aP1e.gif[/img]

Hi everyone!

Have you been enjoying Laser Disco Defenders on Steam? Want a chance to play the game on another platform, or maybe have a friend that plays on consoles only? 

Laser Disco Defenders is now out on the PS4, there's a launch discount for PS+ members and it even includes the PS Vita version.

https://store.playstation.com/#!/search/q=laser%20disco%20defenders

We also have a competition which anyone can enter for a chance to win ticketmaster vouchers. You can enter by clicking the link below and filling out a short form.

http://www.laserdiscodefenders.com/

Stay groovy!

notes.title: Back from EGX! Patch for mouse sensitivity and localization incoming
notes.content:
Hey Alexander here with a little post-EGX update. Together with the rest of the guys from Excalibur Publishing I had lot of fun showing the game, and see the new changes such as powerups and the Groovy Grotto zone being received well by the players. I also got to show the game on the twitch stage which you can check out [url=https://www.twitch.tv/twitch/v/90897621]here[/url] around the 2.24 mark.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26019838/bf7d7db5dac55f685cd1c210b81f95dc0aa6fcb5.jpg[/img]

Now where I am back from EGX I can start to focus the game again. For those of you with a review code that are playing with mouse and keyboards, will probably have noticed the game doesn't feature a way to change the mouse sensitivity. I'm currently working on addressing that and it should hopefully be out when the game launches or the day after. That patch will also aim to fix issues with some of the mission descriptions being too long in certain languages.

notes.title: Steam n' Stream - Alexander Birke To Stream With Auroch Digital Today
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26019838/3e0ec5aa09b87d410720ead9db7882f3ce073a37.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

Welcome to the Laser Disco Defenders Steam page! We've had some great reviews for the game during its Vita launch period and have been working very hard on making the game even better since then.

The PC version will have some new features that we can't wait to share with you! Actually, why should we wait?! Alexander Birke, the developer of Laser Disco Defenders will be on the Auroch Digital Stream later today to show off just some of the new additions made to Laser Disco Defenders since its Vita release. 

The stream will start at 4.30 pm UK time today!

https://www.twitch.tv/aurochdigital
